regulation: UPERC MYT Regulations — the revenue gap (surplus) carried forward with its carrying cost
note: The regulatory asset (or liability) of each year: the opening balance, the year's gap or surplus, the carrying cost on them, the closing.

rules.title: Carrying cost on the revenue gap (surplus)

addition.note: the year's gap (positive) or surplus (negative) — or the reverse, as long as opening and addition share the sign convention

clause.regulation: UPERC MYT Regulations — carrying cost on the revenue gap (surplus): on the opening balance and half the year's addition, at a rate the case supplies

rules.note: draft: the convention both NPCL's format (ARR row 62: '(J59 + J58/2) × rate') and the order's Table 7-1 follow for FY2024-25; the rate is an input because the two differ on it — NPCL's format carries a gap at the working-capital rate and a surplus at 75 % of the bank rate, the order carries FY2024-25's surplus at the working-capital rate and FY2025-26's at 4.86 % 'after consideration of working capital adjustments'.  Unverified until a person reads the Regulations.
